senses.definition: n.m. ψ 65:14 pasture (√ dub.; Thes der. from כַּר lamb (= lamb-pasturage); SchwallyZAW x. (1890) 186 from כרה, and comp. Assyrian kirû [which however = nursery of trees, grove DlHWB 353], Arabic كُرٌّ cistern; HomNS 100 from כרר q.v., orig. = round enclosure);—sg. only כַּר נִרְחָ֑ב Is 30:23 a roomy pasture; pl. כָּרִים ψ 37:20, לָֽבְשׁוּ כ׳ הַצֹּאן 65:14 the pastures are clothed with the sheep (> Schwally l.c. who tr. lambs ψ 37:20 after Aq 𝔖 𝔗, and 65:14, and underst. Is 30:23 of a def. pl.).—iii. כַּר lamb v. sub כרר.
